description: The chart represents the distribution of emotion categories in the IEMOCAP dataset. The pie chart is divided into six slices, each representing a different emotion category, with percentage labels displayed inside the slices. The slices are labeled as follows: Frustration (light blue, 25.1%), Neutral (blue, 23.1%), Anger (yellow, 14.9%), Sadness (orange, 14.7%), Excitement (red, 14.1%), and Happiness (dark orange, 8.1%). The chart does not include a legend, and the slices are arranged in no particular order by size. The percentages are directly labeled on the chart, making it clear what proportion each emotion category represents.
